correction_note: Full recovery of the 56-dimension Packet-012 prose registry and 64-dimension Packet-013 reader registry proves several initially proposed new reader/suspense systems already exist as designed authorities. Those capabilities must be reused/materialized rather than reinvented.
rules: Do not create a new system when an existing Creative Excellence or Literary Prose authority already owns the capability.
Referenced-but-unrecovered pre-012 packet contents may not be invented.

A capability is not closed merely because it appears in a prompt or specialist list; material capabilities require an explicit contract, evidence representation, decision rule and qualification owner.
No scalar literary quality score may compensate for hard preservation, applicability, canon, rights or evidence failures.
Author authority, canon, protected language and project-specific voice remain non-transferable hard authorities.

recovered_strong_authorities.PCE014_HUMAN_READER: Human-reader calibration, disagreement/minority preservation, instrument/order bias, privacy and holdout calibration are already designed; runtime empirical evidence remains open.

recovered_strong_authorities.PCE017_018_WHOLE_BOOK_ASSURANCE: Multi-resolution whole-book evaluation, contradiction/debt architecture and an adversarial runtime harness already exist as recovered authorities and should be reused rather than replaced.
